title: Combined configuration: the fourth cell of the depth x vocabulary factorial

preregistered_predictions.P-C1: C4kL4 exact tuple match is within seed noise of V2 V4k (86.8%): |delta| < 3 pp, i.e. depth 4 costs nothing at V=4k just as it cost nothing at V=24k.
preregistered_predictions.P-C2: Latency is about half of V2 V4k (L8) - ~110-120 ms vs ~210 ms in the reference decoder.
preregistered_predictions.P-C3: The two factors are additive: C4kL4 - D4 (vocab effect at L4) is within 3 pp of V2V4k - W384 (vocab effect at L8, +7.7 pp).
preregistered_predictions.decision_rule: Per-seed exact McNemar C4kL4 vs V2 V4k and vs D4 on the 2,000 paired rows, Stouffer, Holm; adopt only with Holm p<0.05 and consistent seed signs.
